goal: Increase CoTra effective in-flight queries beyond 1024 and measure search-only throughput, excluding query/index load and recall computation from the QPS timing.
search_only_timing: From immediately before ScalaANN_v3 query injection loop to the moment each rank has received all local retrieval results; recall and term/print aggregation are excluded. Cluster QPS is parsed offline as total_query_count / max(rank_search_us).
